<section class="academic-copy" aria-label="Biography">
<h1>Jong Rock Jeong</h1>
<p class="academic-position">M.A. Student in Political Science and International Relations</p>
<p class="academic-institution">Korea University · Seoul, South Korea</p>

<p>I am an M.A. student in Political Science and International Relations at Korea University, where I am advised by Professor Hyeok Yong Kwon. I hold a B.A. in Political Science and International Relations and a B.Ec. in Statistics from Korea University.</p>

<p>My research focuses on <strong>comparative and historical political economy</strong>. I study how states build institutions, mobilize resources, and respond to local political demands, as well as how historical political conflict shapes contemporary political behavior.</p>

<p>My work combines historical data with quantitative methods, including causal inference, Bayesian statistics, and computational text analysis.</p>

<p class="academic-interests"><strong>Research interests</strong><br />Political Economy · Historical Political Economy · State Capacity · Political Methodology</p>
